name: nitgoa-workspace
description: NIT Goa Official Website - Full Stack Application

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm run install-client && npm run install-server
scripts.cleanup-ports: lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true && lsof -ti:3001 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true && echo '🧹 Ports 3000 and 3001 cleaned up'
scripts.dev: npm run cleanup-ports && concurrently "npm run dev-server" "npm run dev-client"
scripts.start: npm run cleanup-ports && npm run dev
scripts.test: npm run test-client && npm run test-server
scripts.lint: npm run lint-client && npm run lint-server
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && firebase hosting:channel:deploy staging
scripts.start-server: npm run cleanup-ports && cd server && npm start
scripts.start-client: npm run cleanup-ports && cd client && npm start
scripts.stop: lsof -ti:3000,3001 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || echo '✅ All development servers stopped'

author: NIT Goa Development Team
